seo.title: Mark Newell Tree Care – Tree Surgeon in Stratford-upon-Avon & Warwickshire
seo.description: Fully qualified and insured tree surgeon based in Stratford-upon-Avon, covering Warwickshire, Worcestershire and the Cotswolds. Felling, reductions, pruning, stump grinding and more.

hero.lead: Mark Newell is a fully qualified and insured tree surgeon with a national diploma in tree management and arboriculture. All work undertaken is fully insured and meets British Standard 3998 requirements.

heading: What customers
say about us.
reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: Superb job by Mark and his assistant in sorting out a number of our trees. They clearly care very much about trees and their care. Mark gives truthful advice about what to do and not to do, isn’t looking for work to make money, but to do the right thing by trees and his customers. … Highly highly recommended.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: This is the fifth time I have used Mark Newell Tree Care and that in itself is testament to how reliably good he is. He is very experienced: we are in a conservation area and he takes care of all the permissions and paperwork etc. He is also very clear about costs and schedules. … Highly recommended.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Mark and his team did a superb job at our house. … Mark took care of everything from applying for conservation permission to work on the trees, to carrying out the work over two days and to tidying everything. The trees look great and the garden was left spotless. Thank you.
items.label: Which? review
